summary.text: Joe Lisuzzo is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Lola Smallwood-Cuevas.
A Los Angeles business owner, he has owned the Al Gelato restaurant and ice cream company for about 30 years, according to a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Joe Lisuzzo was born in Chicago, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Northridge in 1999 and a master's degree from UCLA in 2001.
In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2021, he said he grew up in a large family and was one of the first of his siblings to attend college.
He said he helped his parents open their restaurant, Al Gelato on Robertson Boulevard in West Los Angeles, and worked there for 32 years.
